# Checkpoint

Investigating import API validation override. `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`), so repository searches use `grep`/`find`. No changes made yet.

Root cause: POST does not read the query flag; `add_book.load` has no override argument and calls `validate_record` without one. `validate_record` unconditionally runs the four publication/publisher/ISBN rejection paths. The existing `validate_publication_year` override only suppresses old dates, so bypassing that call in `validate_record` is needed for future dates. Required fields must remain enforced. Existing request code uses `web.input` and explicit string equality for query booleans. Hypothesis: propagate a parsed `true` query value through POST and load, then guard these three validation groups in `validate_record`.

Failing regression tests before implementation: `python -m pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_add_book.py -k test_validate_record_override` failed because `validate_record` rejects the keyword; `python -m pytest -q openlibrary/plugins/importapi/tests/test_code.py -k test_importapi_post_passes_validation_override` failed for true values because POST did not forward the flag. Combined utility test collection failed because `is_promise_item` is absent.

Test runner option attempt failed: `python -m pytest -q -p no:rerunfailures ...` exits 4 because repository `pyproject.toml` passes `--reruns=3`, which the disabled plugin would normally recognize. Rerunning with normal pytest options.

Implemented: POST parses `override-validation=true` from GET query input (case-insensitive); `load` forwards the boolean; `validate_record` skips publication year, independent publisher, and source ISBN checks only when override is true. Added case-insensitive `is_promise_item` utility. Added regression coverage for defaults, explicit false/true, required fields, load forwarding, POST parsing, and promise prefixes.

Verification: `python -m pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests openlibrary/plugins/importapi/tests openlibrary/tests/catalog/test_utils.py` exited 0: 148 passed, 1 xfailed. `git diff --check` exited 0. `python -m ruff check openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_add_book.py openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py openlibrary/plugins/importapi/code.py openlibrary/plugins/importapi/tests/test_code.py openlibrary/tests/catalog/test_utils.py` exited 1 on `openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py:4:1 UP035` (`Mapping` import should come from `collections.abc`). `git show HEAD:openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py | python -m ruff check --stdin-filename openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py -` reproduces the identical lint failure on the baseline, so this is pre-existing and unrelated to the patch.
